narrative.overview: This task-first workspace is clear and restrained: a black ground, charcoal surfaces, white ink, and sky-blue data support readable controls and state. Depth comes from flat tonal layering and dividers rather than shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Visible labels and generous control targets.
Confirmed facts remain distinct from delayed updates.
Synthetic data and disposable prototype scope remain explicit.
dos: Do treat Dashboard as summary and Dailies as management; the duplicated comparison view was a prototype limitation, not architecture.
Do keep URL-scoped date/status, immediate completion, and confirmed-fact gating with explicit delayed-update feedback.
donts: Don't treat this delta as approval to merge, or extend its authority past the prototype branches. Production ../DESIGN.md is untouched.
Don't read the static History fixtures or simulated failure states as backend behavior.
